$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:station_share reading for requirement lines. Its Param is a stat and a station joined by @ (RPG_Disenchanting_Proficiency@Disenchanting_Table), and it reads only what the talents bound to working at that station add to the stat, whether the player is there or not, leaving out gear and buffs: what a roll that pays for the talents alone reads. The name covers the factor whatever stat and station a Param picks.
